messages.en: Where do you want to put that wooden chest?
Just in the storeroom. It's heavy—give me a hand carrying it.
I'm here. Where do I register?
Just ask the staff member at the entrance. He can help you.
I've tried so many times already. Come on, just give me one hint.
Okay, look at the picture on the left first.

senses.en_definition: A party, group, or organization involved in a matter, especially one of two opposing sides.
A side or lateral part of something.
A direction from which something comes or towards which it extends.

messages.en: Has the school got back to you yet? I'd like to know if the trip is going ahead.
Not yet. The teacher said they're waiting for confirmation of the bus arrangements first. I'll post an update in the group when I hear more, okay?
